column4: A single shipping container sits dead centre on an empty background, lit like a museum artifact on a plinth. Perfectly still and symmetrical, absolutely no movement. The container is the only orange object in frame. Locked-off camera.
The centred shipping container rotates slowly and smoothly through exactly ninety degrees, then stops and holds completely still. Locked-off camera.

Wide cross-section of a 1940s cargo ship hold. Dozens of charcoal silhouette figures hand-stack mismatched cargo: sacks, barrels, crates of every different size, loose timber. Deliberately chaotic, no two objects alike, no grid or order. Slow lateral drift left to right.

Closer view inside a crowded ship hold, charcoal silhouette dockworkers lifting irregular sacks and barrels onto an uneven stack. Cluttered and disordered, continuous overlapping motion. Locked-off camera.
A ship hold packed with mismatched cargo, charcoal silhouette figures wedging a barrel into an awkward gap between crates of different sizes. Slow lateral camera drift.
Charcoal silhouette dockworkers fitting irregular cargo together like puzzle pieces in a ship hold, each item a different shape, nothing repeating. Continuous hand-stacking motion. Locked-off camera.

Wide side view of a cargo ship moored at a dock. A stylised sun arcs across the sky behind it three times. The ship itself does not move at all. Orange accent on the ship hull only. Locked-off camera.
The same moored cargo ship, stylised suns arcing across the sky faster and faster, the ship still completely motionless. Orange accent on the hull only. Locked-off camera.
A horizontal route diagram draws itself across an empty frame: a dock segment, then a long open ocean segment, then another dock segment. Thin uniform charcoal lines. Locked-off camera.
On the horizontal route diagram, the two end dock segments begin to swell thicker while the long middle ocean segment stays thin and pale. Locked-off camera.
A horizontal cost diagram where the long middle ocean segment is thin and pale and barely visible, emphasising how little it contributes. Gentle pulsing on the pale segment. Locked-off camera.
A horizontal diagram where the two short end segments are enormous and orange, dwarfing the thin pale line between them. The orange segments pulse gently. Locked-off camera.
A finished horizontal cost diagram, two massive orange blocks at either end joined by a thin pale thread, held steady and unchanging. Locked-off camera.
Side view: a truck parked beside a cargo ship at a dock, both rendered as clean charcoal outlines. Still and composed, nothing moving yet. Locked-off camera.
Charcoal silhouette figures carry goods out of the parked truck and into the ship one item at a time, walking a repeating loop between the two. Continuous looping motion. Locked-off camera.
The looping charcoal figures fade to low opacity and the walking path between truck and ship illuminates in orange, revealing the redundant double handling. Locked-off camera.
A converted tanker at a dock. One orange shipping container lifts smoothly from a truck chassis and lands precisely on the deck. Single smooth motion. Locked-off camera.
The camera pulls back steadily from the tanker deck to reveal dozens of identical containers already aligned in a perfect orderly grid. One smooth continuous pull-back, no cuts.
One orange shipping container at centre. A charcoal outline crane descends to grip it and visibly fails to fit, the jaws too narrow for the container. The mismatch flashes briefly. Locked-off camera.
One orange shipping container at centre beside a charcoal outline ship slot. The container is lowered toward the slot and does not fit, too wide by a clear margin. Locked-off camera.
One orange shipping container above a charcoal outline truck chassis. It lowers and fails to seat, overhanging the chassis on both sides. Locked-off camera.
One orange shipping container above a charcoal outline rail car. It lowers and fails to fit, too tall and unstable on the flatbed. Locked-off camera.
One orange shipping container at a charcoal outline port gate. It approaches and cannot pass through, the opening plainly the wrong dimensions. Locked-off camera.
Four shipping containers of visibly different dimensions sit in a row, each outlined in a different shade of charcoal. Still and evenly spaced. Locked-off camera.
Measurement lines and dimension arrows extend outward from each of the four mismatched containers, overlapping into a dense conflicting tangle. Locked-off camera.

A dense tangle of conflicting dimension lines and measurement arrows over four mismatched container outlines, the lines crossing and contradicting each other. Slight restless movement. Locked-off camera.
The tangle of conflicting dimension lines begins to resolve as two of the four mismatched containers shrink away and vanish. Locked-off camera.
Exactly two containers remain, one short and one exactly twice its length, and both turn orange. The clean one-to-two length ratio reads instantly. Locked-off camera.

A single orange shipping container moves in smooth unbroken horizontal motion into a charcoal silhouette crane, which accepts it without pausing or adjusting. Camera tracks alongside at constant speed.
The orange container continues its unbroken horizontal motion from the crane into a charcoal silhouette ship, accepted seamlessly. Camera tracks alongside at constant speed.
The orange container continues its unbroken horizontal motion from the ship onto a charcoal silhouette train, accepted seamlessly. Camera tracks alongside at constant speed.
The orange container continues its unbroken horizontal motion from the train onto a charcoal silhouette truck, accepted seamlessly. Camera tracks alongside at constant speed.
The orange container continues moving in perfect mechanical rhythm through charcoal silhouette handling systems, hypnotic and constant. Camera tracks alongside at constant speed.
A dense crowd of charcoal silhouette dockworkers fills the entire frame, standing still. Entirely charcoal and off-white, no accent colour anywhere. Locked-off camera.
The charcoal silhouette dockworkers at the edges of the crowd begin fading out one by one, slowly and unhurried. No accent colour anywhere. Locked-off camera.
More charcoal silhouette dockworkers fade away from the outside inward, the crowd visibly thinning. No accent colour anywhere. Locked-off camera.
Only a scattered few charcoal silhouette figures remain on a mostly empty dock, fading one at a time. No accent colour anywhere. Locked-off camera.
An empty dock with a single automated crane moving alone, no people at all. Entirely charcoal and off-white, cold and still. Locked-off camera.
A charcoal screw thread appears at centre frame and turns smoothly into a matching orange threaded socket, seating cleanly and precisely. Locked-off camera.
A charcoal wooden pallet appears at centre frame and slides cleanly into a matching orange forklift opening, fitting exactly. Locked-off camera.
A charcoal railway track gauge appears at centre frame and aligns cleanly onto matching orange rails, seating perfectly. Locked-off camera.
A charcoal electrical plug appears at centre frame and tries to enter an orange socket, but does not fit and sits askew and unmatched. Locked-off camera.
A charcoal electrical plug rests unmatched and slightly askew beside an orange socket of plainly the wrong shape, held unresolved and motionless. Locked-off camera.
A single shipping container centred on a plinth, completely still, framed exactly like an opening museum shot. Absolute stillness. Locked-off camera.
The centred shipping container on its plinth holds perfectly still and unchanging, composed and symmetrical, leaving clear empty space beneath it. Locked-off camera.
